cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Really Happened?
cards.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. For this missing-parcel form: was it a bag or a box? You've said both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A bag, I think. I carried it by the handles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Describe the handles. Were they attached to fabric or cardboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cardboard. It had a rigid lid, too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why 'bag'? Tell me again what you carried. Was the box inside something?

mechanism: A supervises a precise reconstruction of packaging to test which version of the handover stays consistent.
confusable: Suspicion alone lacks the correction of imprecise categories; S03 distinguishes observations from labels.
comparison: Parcel packaging reconstruction differs from the lost-bag scene's location and hurried movement.
seedUse: Use the handles/cardboard ambiguity; develop it through actual layers of packaging rather than a detached professional wrapper.
